video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners what a database index is and why it makes a lookup by email fast

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained, then back out to show everything

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of a table or card draws itself, then the card fills in

table_rows_wipe.what: Each row of a table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

chip_wipe.what: A small label chip is revealed from left to right

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

scan_band_enter.what: A violet outlined band fades in over the first row of the customers table

scan_band_step.what: The violet band slides down from one row of the table to the next

scan_band_exit.what: The violet band fades away after the last row

scan_row_dim.what: A row that is not the one being looked for fades from navy to pale gray

scan_check_draw.what: A violet check mark fades in beside the row that matches

counter_count.what: The number of rows checked counts upward steadily to two million

rows_restore.what: The pale rows of the table return to navy

email_chip_enter.what: A white chip with a violet outline fades in around an email in the table

email_travel.what: A copy of an email travels from the table into its alphabetical place in the index

email_chip_exit.what: The chip around the travelling email fades away as it lands

query_line_out.what: A line of the query slides up and fades out

query_line_in.what: A new line of the query slides up into its place

row_numbers_enter.what: A row number fades in beside each email in the index, one after another

pointer_link_draw.what: A glowing violet line draws itself from an index entry across to its row in the table

pointer_link_exit.what: The line between the index and the table fades away

search_band_enter.what: A lavender band fades in on the middle entry of the index

search_band_jump.what: The lavender band jumps to the middle of the entries that are left

search_half_dim.what: The half of the index that cannot hold the email fades from navy to pale gray

found_check_draw.what: A violet check mark fades in beside the entry that was found

found_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the matching row of the table

index_restore.what: The pale entries of the index return to navy and the lavender band fades away

new_row_slide_in.what: A new row inside a white chip slides up into the first free line of the table

cards_grow.what: The table and the index each get one row taller

index_make_room.what: The entries below the new email's place move down one line

new_email_travel.what: A copy of the new email travels from the table into its place in the index

where_mark_wipe.what: A lavender band spreads from left to right behind the WHERE line of the query

email_column_ring.what: A violet outline draws itself around the email column of the table
